acts.RM.title: The Riddle Corridor
characters.player_blank.name: The Unwritten
encounters.RM-1.maze.beats.0.hint: Hint: the inscription runs backwards — start from the last word and read toward the first.
encounters.RM-1.maze.beats.0.text: The inscription flickers in the torchlight. It seems to be… written backwards?
encounters.RM-2.maze.beats.0.text: A riddle scrap on the stone table, its ink looking almost wet.
encounters.RM-2.maze.beats.1.hint: Hint: the timeline is missing a page — the year that was revoked.
encounters.RM-2.maze.beats.1.text: On the back of the scrap is a timeline, with one year neatly cut out.
encounters.RM-3.maze.beats.0.hint: Hint: the notches aren't numbers, they're tide levels. Count the rises and falls.
encounters.RM-3.maze.beats.0.text: The Fatedie turns slowly, its notches cut deep and shallow — like a record of the tide rising and falling.
endings.R-END.content: Solved: the corridor folds its answer into your codex.
endings.R-END.title: The Answer
items.riddle_page.name: Riddle Scrap
lore.fatedie_study_riddle: The die at the end of the corridor isn't marked with pips but with tide levels. The old Unwritten say the Fatedie was a tide table all along: what you roll isn't luck, but how high the water stands in this harbor at that moment — and only between the rise and the fall is there room to rewrite.
lore.fatedie_study_riddle.title: Treatise on the Fatedie · The Tide Die
manifest.name: Riddle Maze
nodes.R-0.edges.0.label: Enter the Riddle Corridor
nodes.R-0.summary: Beneath the scribing hall's floor lies an even older corridor. Its door knocker is a Fatedie with no numbers — it doesn't lock the door, only the answer.
nodes.R-0.title: The Corridor Entrance
nodes.R-1.edges.0.label: Cross the chamber
nodes.R-1.summary: The walls are covered in faded inscriptions. Only when you understand them will the far door appear.
nodes.R-1.title: Chamber One · The Inscription
nodes.R-2.edges.0.label: Go deeper
nodes.R-2.summary: A riddle page lies open on a stone table, its ink looking almost wet. Take it first, then solve it.
nodes.R-2.title: Chamber Two · The Scrap
nodes.R-3.edges.0.label: Push open the door at the end
nodes.R-3.summary: A Fatedie hangs in the middle of the last chamber, and its notches aren't numbers — they're tide levels.
nodes.R-3.title: Chamber Three · The Fatedie
nodes.R-END.summary: There's no treasure room behind the door, only one line of small print: "Whoever answers rightly takes the corridor with them." Your codex grows a little thicker.
nodes.R-END.title: The Answer
